entities.name: Greek Olympic Games
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Held every four years at Olympia in honor of Zeus. Athletes competed nude, women were banned from attending, and all Greek wars paused during the Olympic Truce (ekecheiria). Winners received only olive wreaths — but became heroes in their home city-states. The Games ran continuously for 1,168 years.
